findings.evidence: Weight/Tensor.lean:245-246 and Weight/Basic.lean:228-229 are the same term modulo the spanning argument; `grep -rn "isInternal_weightSpace" TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/` returns only the two special cases `isInternal_weightSpace_stdRep` and `isInternal_weightSpace_tprod`, no general form. `iSupIndep_weightSpace` (Weight/Basic.lean:218) is already stated for an arbitrary `ρ`, so the general lemma needs no new hypothesis.
findings.fix: Add to Weight/Basic.lean, in the `Field` section next to `iSupIndep_weightSpace`: `theorem isInternal_weightSpace (hchar : Function.Injective (weightChar k (κ := Fin n))) {ρ : Representation k (GL (Fin n) k) W} (h : ⨆ l : Fin n → ℤ, weightSpace ρ l = ⊤) : DirectSum.IsInternal fun l : Fin n → ℤ ↦ weightSpace ρ l := (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top _).mpr ⟨iSupIndep_weightSpace hchar _, h⟩`, then make both corollaries one-liners: `isInternal_weightSpace_stdRep hchar := isInternal_weightSpace hchar iSup_weightSpace_stdRep_eq_top` and `isInternal_weightSpace_tprod hchar hρ hσ := isInternal_weightSpace hchar (iSup_weightSpace_tprod_eq_top hρ hσ)`.
findings.issue: `isInternal_weightSpace_tprod` inlines the general argument `⟨iSupIndep_weightSpace hchar _, spanning⟩` rather than deriving from a general lemma. Nothing in that proof is specific to `ρ.tprod σ`: given `hchar`, any `ρ` with `⨆ l, weightSpace ρ l = ⊤` is the internal direct sum of its weight spaces. The identical two lines are already inlined at Weight/Basic.lean:226-229 for `stdRep`, and every further case the roadmap needs (symmetric, exterior, tensor powers) would inline them again.

summary: Levels and hypotheses on the tensor-product results are right (spanning-only hypotheses, `det ^ m` twist proved over a commutative ring for arbitrary `ρ`). One gap: the general "weight spaces span ⇒ internal direct sum" lemma is inlined for the tensor product instead of proved once for an arbitrary representation, duplicating the same two-line argument already inlined for `stdRep`.
